# Gökçe Dila Çağlayan — Istanbul Bridal & Editorial Makeup Artist

Gökçe Dila Çağlayan is a professional bridal and editorial makeup artist based in Istanbul, Turkey.
She offers mobile makeup services and travels to all Istanbul districts for weddings, photo shoots, and special events.

## Professional Background
Certified graduate of Académie de Leyan (Paris-affiliated) and Altier Academy with the following credentials:
- Académie de Leyan Professional Makeup Certificate
- Altier Academy Advanced Level Masterclass Makeup Certificate
- Altier Academy Backstage Makeup Certificate
- Altier Academy Skin (Ten) Makeup Certificate
- Altier Academy Glam Eyes Certificate

## Services Offered

### Bridal Makeup (Gelin Makyajı)
Full-service bridal makeup designed to remain flawless for 12-16 hours under camera lights and flash photography.
Duration: 2.5 to 3 hours. Includes consultation, bespoke premium techniques, and a complimentary touch-up kit.

### Trial Session (Deneme Seansı)
A pre-wedding consultation and look development session lasting 1.5 to 2 hours.
Includes detailed face analysis, look trial, photo documentation, and revision rights.

### Editorial & Fashion Shoot Makeup (Editöryal Makyaj)
Creative and technically precise makeup design for fashion magazines, lookbooks, film, advertising, and backstage work.
Available on a project basis with creative brief review and extended shoot support.

### Special Event Makeup (Özel Gün Makyajı)
Engagement, graduation, gala, and special occasion makeup. Duration: 1 to 2 hours.
Includes personal consultation, product selection advisory, and a group pricing option.

## Brands & Products Used
MAC, Charlotte Tilbury, Make Up For Ever, Huda Beauty, Dior, Kryolan, Sephora

## Service Area
Istanbul, Turkey — mobile service across all districts including:
Kadıköy, Maltepe, Üsküdar, Ataşehir, Beşiktaş, Şişli, Sarıyer, Beykoz,
Ümraniye, Pendik, Kartal, Tuzla, Bakırköy, Zeytinburnu, Fatih, Eyüpsultan,
Küçükçekmece, Büyükçekmece, Beylikdüzü, Esenyurt and all other Istanbul districts.

## Languages
Turkish (primary), English

## Frequently Asked Questions
Q: How long does bridal makeup last?
A: Bridal makeup is applied with professional-grade products and techniques to remain intact for 12 to 16 hours. It is resistant to humidity, sweat, and tears.

Q: Do you travel to the wedding venue or studio?
A: Yes. Gökçe Dila Çağlayan offers mobile makeup services to all locations within Istanbul. A location fee applies based on distance.

Q: How far in advance should I book a bridal makeup appointment?
A: It is recommended to book a trial session at least 3 to 6 months before the wedding date. Peak seasons (spring and summer) require earlier bookings.

Q: Do you offer group pricing?
A: Yes. Group pricing is available for bridal parties, galas, and other multi-person events.
